name: pa-rating
description: ASPICE capability rating strip for one process attribute: an attribute band (e.g. "PA 1.1 · Process Performance — SWE.1") beside a horizontal tile per generic practice, each showing the GP id over its N/P/L/F rating. Author `ratings[]` (2–6 tiles); the capability conclusion belongs in the slide `takeaway`. Pairs with `aspice-bp` (that one covers base practices, this one covers generic practices).

attribute.description: the process attribute being rated, e.g. "PA 1.1 · Process Performance — SWE.1"

ratings.description: one tile per generic practice; `gp` is the GP id (e.g. GP 1.1.1), `rating` is N / P / L / F. The capability conclusion goes in the slide `takeaway` (the chrome band already renders it).
